record.label: Qubit and T-gate budgets for fault-tolerant hardware
record.statement: The authors compare end-to-end logical resource estimates with estimates of the qubit and $T$-gate budgets of future fault-tolerant devices. They conclude that the reported simulations require further resource reductions to run on early devices.
record.boundary: Section 3 identifies error-correcting code choice, routing and physical layout as further targets for formal specification.
